Chapter 6691: Hope For An Immortal

Chapter 6691: Hope For An Immortal

The abyss was real, no longer a vision. The core of Fiendish Ground now belonged to Primal Yin Immortal Ghost.

“An immortal ascension?” Someone whispered.

“Another immortal then.” A primal ancestor said.

Other overlords agreed after seeing the ghost’s state. After all, he had just devoured a primordial immortal, albeit not the whole body. Perhaps he was one step or even half a step away.

He and Bao Pu exchanged glances before staring at Weizhen for a split second. Everything became tense as if this world was within their grasp. If they strengthened their grip, everything would be crushed.

Top cultivators became tense because these two had just reached a frightening level. They felt something akin to a murderous intent. This only lasted briefly but was still enough to kill anyone.

A thought surfaced in everyone’s mind like an illusion - was it time for them to kill Weizhen and Supreme Heaven? Destroy Life and Death Heaven? Devour Three Immortals...

This thought invaded the minds of overlords, not just weaker cultivators.

Bao Pu was now an actual immortal. Only primordial immortals could defeat him but they were all dead.

Primal Yin Immortal Ghost was half a step away but possessed the power of an immortal. Moreover, he had a bigger advantage than Bao Pu, having fused perfectly with the primordial Fiendish Ground. This was their time to flatten and devour everything.

Contrary to everyone’s expectation, Weizhen had a calm expression and didn’t bat an eye.

“Congratulations, Fellow Daoists, for ascending to the immortal realm.” He bowed slightly and said.

“Looks like he still has an ace card.” Listeners speculated.

Since the two immortals didn’t make their move, others thought killing Weizhen wouldn’t be easy. He still had the three corpses and perhaps more contingencies.

“Thank you for helping, Brother.” Both cupped their fist and bowed.

“I hope you will not forget our agreement.” Weizhen cupped his fist.

“Of course.” They agreed since a formal promise had to be carried out even for immortals.

Everyone exchanged glances. Was Weizhen the biggest winner?

He eliminated the two primordial immortals and had an existing promise with the new immortals.

Meanwhile, a golden tribulation still kept Lord of Life and Death busy.

“She’s becoming an immortal properly.” A spectator said while watching her contest against the monstrous tribulation.

This tribulation was mightier than any previous tribulation. If she could surpass it, she would surely become a primordial immortal in the future.

“Almost.” Weizhen had a serious expression.

Other parties hoped for her success - a perfect and righteous immortal. They felt unsafe after Bao Pu and the ghost’s success. After all, they couldn’t forget that murderous intent just now. Three Immortals was far safer with her as an immortal.

“Go!” Bao Pu and the ghost agreed with the next move, leaping into space and seemingly dragging Three Immortals with them. Everyone knew what they wanted to do.

“Stop!” Supreme Black Ancestor and his allies yelled.
